description: This file defines application configuration settings for a backend API, utilizing pydantic for environment variable management, including database connection setup, server configuration, and CORS settings.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: A pydantic-based class that loads and validates application settings from environment variables, with logic to construct database URLs from legacy variables if needed.

methods.name: build_or_validate_db_url
methods.description: Validator method that constructs the DATABASE_URL from legacy POSTGRES_* variables if not explicitly provided.

methods.name: validate_port
methods.description: Validator method that ensures the PORT value is within valid range (1-65535).

methods.name: get_settings
methods.description: Function that loads and caches the Settings instance for application-wide use.
